method: stress_safe_family_sims HBM-like 2 kV bench (1.33 A, 2 ns / 150 ns, unpowered, VDD 0 V via 1 ohm + 100 nF) + every consumer block on the pad nets (chip_assembly/netlist.py PATHS), flattened from the published extracted netlists; all consumer MOS observed; gate screen = spec limit (3.63 V 3.3 V devices, 6.0 V 6 V devices). Unbound consumer ports 100 kohm to 0; *_jn adds 10 um2 n+/p+ drain junctions of the unpowered driver. Matrix P_pos tt/27, P_pos ss/0, P_neg ss/0. Compact-model diagnostic, not HBM qualification.
